title: DELETE /api/projects/:id — soft delete project
description: Soft delete a project by setting deleted_at. The project and its data remain in the database for potential recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Sets deleted_at = NOW() on the project
Deleted project no longer appears in GET /api/projects list
Returns 404 if project not found or already deleted

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject(id, userId). 2) Update project set deleted_at = new Date() where id = project.id. 3) Return 200 { message: 'Project deleted' }.
Create project, delete it, verify it's gone from GET /api/projects. Check DB directly — verify deleted_at is set, data still exists.
